assumptions: Toy length180 and width78 mm are authored; measured reference bbox ratio is2.994. Equal33 mm wheels rectify perspective.
Baseline has6 mm shafts,6.5 mm journals,5 mm lands and70 mm wheel track; exact source validates service travel and winding drum.
Only a quarter-turn operating motion is demonstrated. Full360 degree rigid wheel clearance is checked separately; it is not a validated elastic turn limit.
Eight printed occurrences from six unique printable geometries, plus required purchased elastic; optional traction loops. Windows and keyed end wheels require plastic-compatible adhesive.

build_plan.exit_criteria: Source journal clearance, axle capture, floor clearance and full rotational sweep pass.
Reference landmark, wall and service-travel checks pass.
Document real elastic uncertainty, relaxed-loop fit and open-finger release. Source motion checks pass without claiming physical travel.

concept.interaction: Press the underside thumb latch, slide the shell rearward4 mm and lift. Fit the replaceable elastic loop over the front peg and rear radial finger. Close and latch the shell, roll backward one quarter wheel-turn to tension the loop, and release nose-first. Reopen and rehook the slack loop for tool-free reset.
concept.print_stance: Chassis flat, shell nose-down with axial buttresses and sloped arch relief, axles upright on their integral wheel with brim, separate end wheels socket-up, windows flat. Exact thickness and overhang reports qualify these digital stances.
risks: Elastic force, fatigue, traction and physical run remain untested.
Loose rear finger must disengage the slack loop to avoid reverse winding.
Top and front proportions are inferred; one reference cannot establish prototype width.
concept.signature_decision: Long angular gold body, swept dark glazing and broad disc wheels retain the supplied reference identity.
concept.summary: A gold Cybercab toy with dark swept windows, disc wheels and a removable shell. Roll it backward to tension an elastic loop, then release it nose-first.
concept.title: Cybercab Elastic Drive

design_changes.previous_choice: Four printed pieces, painted windows,1.6 mm walls,2 mm drum and x137 anchor
design_changes.reason: Measured likeness and wall/retention checks required separate dark glazing,2.4 mm walls,3.6 mm roof offset,4.2 mm broad-rooted spool and x134 capped peg. Quarter-turn envelope replaces unsupported full-turn operation.

design_changes.previous_choice: Integral two-wheel axles and enclosed annular wheel grooves
design_changes.reason: Exact overhang checks found unsupported upper wheels and enclosed groove ceilings. Split each axle into an integral-wheel axle and keyed end wheel, remove grooves, thicken socket floors to 1.2 mm, support rear finger with a sloped rib, and provide shell arch relief. Preserve reference exterior and record adhesive retention and elastic loaded-contact uncertainty.

design_changes.previous_choice: Both body and windows marked signature=true.
design_changes.reason: Exactly one signature component required; body remains primary reference object, windows retain unchanged form and role as glazing inserts.

design_changes.reason: Inventory now names nine existing exported occurrences. Optional traction remains an unverified accessory option described in assumptions, not a modeled required part. Geometry, function and visual design unchanged.
